description: This source file implements cache manipulation functions for a Linux kernel loader, specifically handling cache flush operations on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards using LZMA compression. It includes functions to flush cache regions, utilizing architecture-specific assembly instructions.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes the cache for a specified memory region by performing writeback and invalidate operations on cache lines within the given address range.
